name: Reuse standard components before creating local UI primitives
statement: Search for and reuse the central component family for buttons, tabs, panels, status indicators, badges, conversations, and other established primitives before building a feature-local substitute.
rationale: Standard-component reuse carries accessibility, interaction, and visual decisions across the product family. A local look-alike duplicates behavior and is likely to drift.

history.change: Initial rule covering the operator-observed missing component-reuse defect class.
